annotations.title: Disconnect a connected social media account

description: Use this tool only when the user explicitly asks to disconnect a specific connected social media account. It removes the connection identified by client_user_network_id from the authenticated Blog2Social user. This is a destructive action. After disconnection, the account cannot be used for publishing until it is connected again through connections.add.

client_user_network_id.description: Connected social media account ID returned by connections.list.

name: connections.remove

success.description: True when the connected social media account was removed successfully.
